races.paceDynamic: King's Code is the sole confirmed early leader with prominent runners Fireblade, Will Scarlet, Klassleader and Prince Of The Seas likely to press forward, creating a moderate gallop rather than crawling fractions. The majority field comprises hold-up horses including Stressfree, Plage De Havre, Paddy The Squire, Saint Etienne, Sing Us A Song and Dark Moon Rising who will rely on the pace materializing ahead of them. With multiple prominent runners ensuring reasonable tempo but no fierce early battle, this sets up perfectly for closers who can time their runs from off the pace. The race shape strongly favours hold-up horses who can capitalize on the sustained gallop and deliver late strikes.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the moderate early gallop allows closers perfect positioning without being too far back
scenarios.body: King's Code and the prominent runners maintain honest fractions that suit the patient tactics of the hold-up brigade. Stressfree, Plage De Havre and Paddy The Squire can unleash telling late runs when it matters most.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Capitalize
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes stronger than expected, stretching the hold-up horses
scenarios.body: Fireblade and Will Scarlet can press forward from good positions while the closers get too far back to recover. The sustained gallop plays into the hands of those closer to the pace throughout.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: King's Code Wire-To-Wire
scenarios.trigger: If King's Code faces less pressure than expected and gets easy fractions up front
scenarios.body: The leader can dictate terms without serious challenge until late, maintaining enough energy to repel late challenges. Hold-up horses find the pace too steady to generate the necessary turn of foot.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Completely
scenarios.trigger: If King's Code goes too slow and prominent runners fail to apply pressure
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish where tactical positioning trumps stamina, potentially suiting horses with natural speed regardless of usual style. Fresh legs and good draws become decisive factors.

The prominent runners Fireblade, Will Scarlet and Prince Of The Seas applying early pressure to create the tempo hold-up horses need

races.paceDynamic: Desert Falcon is the sole confirmed front runner and will dictate terms from the gate, setting a sustainable gallop without pressure in the early stages. The prominent runners Pocklington, Wicket Keeper, Pilgrim, Sondad, Dark Cloud Rising, We Never Stop and American Style will track just behind but won't apply early pressure. With 15 hold-up horses in the field, the pace will likely be steady early before quickening significantly in the final 2f as the big field bunches up. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses who can find gaps and deliver late kicks in what should develop into a sprint finish.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Desert Falcon sets modest fractions and the field stays bunched entering the final 2f
scenarios.body: The large contingent of closers will have every chance to weave through and time their challenges perfectly. Quality hold-up performers with tactical speed will prosper in the sprint finish.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Strike
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent horses can secure ideal tracking positions and kick before the hold-up brigade mobilizes
scenarios.body: They'll steal crucial lengths in the straight before the closers can respond. The pace-pressers with tactical nous will hold off late challenges.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Desert Falcon Wires Field
scenarios.trigger: If Desert Falcon maintains a strong gallop throughout and the field fails to organize an effective pursuit
scenarios.body: The front runner will have stolen enough of a march to resist all late challenges. His stamina and tactical advantage will prove decisive despite the weight of numbers behind.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Early
scenarios.trigger: If Desert Falcon goes too fast early or gets headed by aggressive prominent runners creating a fierce pace battle
scenarios.body: The early speed duel will set up a devastating finish for the most patient closers arriving with the strongest late kicks. Only horses with explosive finishing speed will be competitive.

races.paceDynamic: Regional stands alone as the only confirmed front runner, likely to dictate proceedings from the gates with sustainable fractions. The prominent runners Quinault, Diligent Harry and Crestofdistinction will track close behind, but none apply serious early pressure. This creates a controlled tempo that builds steadily, with the large cohort of hold-up horses including American Affair, Big Mojo, Kind Of Blue and Time For Sandals relying on the pace collapsing late. The lack of genuine early pace and abundance of closers strongly favours prominent trackers who can position handily and strike before the back markers get organised.

scenarios.label: A

scenarios.trigger: If Regional sets modest fractions with Quinault and Diligent Harry tracking perfectly
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace allows the prominent runners to stay close without effort, then quicken decisively when the hold-up brigade are still getting organised in the straight.

scenarios.label: B

scenarios.body: With no pressure early, Regional conserves energy and holds off the late charge, particularly given his solid recent form at the distance.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Surge
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes truly pedestrian early allowing closers time to wind up
scenarios.body: American Affair, Big Mojo and Time For Sandals get the perfect setup to unleash their finishing kicks from the rear. The front runners pay for the slow tempo.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Completely
scenarios.trigger: If Regional goes too slow and gets swamped by everything
scenarios.body: The entire field converges in a messy finish where positioning becomes crucial and any horse can prevail in a blanket finish.

races.paceDynamic: Awraad is the sole confirmed front runner and will dictate terms from the rail, setting a sustainable pace without pressure from the field of 16. The prominent runners Hasbro Market, Passing Thought, Advance Twentyfive, Inishbeg and First Time will track behind but none are aggressive early types. This creates a steady tempo with the large hold-up contingent including First Legion, Al Najashi, Ellusive Butterfly and Startled settling well back in the pack. The lack of pace pressure early strongly favours hold-up horses who can produce sustained finishes over the final 2-3 furlongs at York.

scenarios.label: A

scenarios.body: The steady pace allows the large pack of hold-up horses to close strongly down the straight. Class horses like Al Najashi, First Legion and Startled can unleash finishing kicks that the early leaders cannot match.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Awraad Wire-to-Wire
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is genuinely slow and no horse can quicken sufficiently
scenarios.body: The front runner maintains his advantage as the field struggles to make up ground in a tactical affair. Awraad's stamina reserves prove decisive when the field lacks the pace to reel him in.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Sprint Finish Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses into a crawl and it becomes a 2-furlong dash
scenarios.body: The race turns into a pure speed test where horses with high cruising speed benefit regardless of style. Late pace and traffic luck become decisive factors in a bunched finish.
